The '''Republic Livestock and Agriculture Administration''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] department that specialized in genetic engineering. Their data was stolen by the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null Arcs]] in order to gather enough information to stop their accelerated aging.<ref name="o66" />
